elements.label: Footage swap behind a white light-streak sweep (portal scene to player in headset)
elements.change_other: light-streak sweep that wipes one footage clip into the next

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: 447 ms before the sweep and in line with the regular music pulses in the spectrogram; may be a pre-roll reverse swoosh or simply a beat.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Low-frequency onset followed by sustained broadband texture reads as a music section change, about 260 ms after the caption settles, not a discrete impact.

pattern.description: White radial light streaks sweep across frame and hide a cut between two footage clips; as they clear, a bold white caption blurs in from slightly larger scale and settles centred over the new shot.
pattern.why_premium: The cut is hidden inside a branded light effect, so the change of scene feels like part of the motion, and the caption lands within the same few frames, giving one clean beat instead of a cut followed by a separate title.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.streaks', {opacity: 1, scaleX: 1.4, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.in'}).set('.clipA', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.clipB', {autoAlpha: 1}).to('.streaks', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}).fromTo('.caption', {opacity: 0, scale: 1.25, filter: 'blur(12px)'}, {opacity: 1, scale: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: Streak overlay opacity via interpolate(frame, [0,3,7], [0,1,0]); swap <Sequence> clips at the streak peak; caption scale from spring({frame: frame-4, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 220, mass: 1}}) mapped 1.25 to 1, opacity and blur via interpolate over 6 frames with Easing.out(Easing.cubic).

notes: The caption's blur-in starts during the streak sweep, so the two motions overlap. b01 covers the whole frame; the light streak itself has no separate candidate box.
